name: CORTIS Documentary: What We Want
overview: ‘What We Want’ is a close-quarters, four-episode documentary tracing CORTIS through the messy, electric work of making a debut. Our cameras live where ideas become performances: late-night writing sessions, choreography workshops, visual development, MV production, and the final push onto the stage. Rather than tell you what to feel, the series lets the process speak—small breakthroughs, scrapped takes, honest feedback, and the stubborn will to try again.
